scope: Read-only resource and current-log observations; no compiler, tuning experiment, source mutation, or active-gate change.

kernel_sysinfo_observation.qualification: Kernel aggregate sysinfo. Free RAM is not MemAvailable and excludes reclaimable cache. No cgroup memory limit/current view, CPU quota view, or compiler peak RSS was available. Unlimited rlimits do not establish absence of a cgroup limit.

gate_log_observation.qualification: Early modules are not representative of dependency-heavy modules or the final audit. These progress observations imply neither terminal success nor future liveness.

assessment.cpu_parallelism: CPU count, affinity, and low aggregate load make parallel compilation plausible.
assessment.jobs4: Not recommended from available evidence: peak compiler memory, available/reclaimable RAM, and effective memory quota are unqualified; zero swap increases the consequence of memory pressure.
assessment.jobs2: A conservative future measured configuration, keeping --threads 1. Potential speedup is plausible but neither size nor safety is established by these read-only observations.
assessment.current_action: Preserve the running serial gate. Root agreed. No optional tuning tests or active-setting changes.
